subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on the political affairs of Formosa
subfiles.about: An index summarizes papers numbered 12–27 concerning political, administrative, ethnic, and strategic developments in Japanese-ruled Taiwan from 1931 through 1940.
subfiles.summary: Docket (1931-40) covers a banned Taiwanese party, Indigenous unrest, press restrictions, and Emmerson's highly rated report on forced Japanization.

interest: Shows 1931-40 US reporting on Taiwan's political unrest, censorship, and forced cultural assimilation.
